base.$description: Primary font used across the product for body text, UI elements, and general readability.

heading.$description: Font used for headings and titles. Can be same as base or slightly more expressive.

mono.$description: Monospaced font used for data, code, and structured content.

display.$description: Monospaced font used for data, code, and structured content.

uppercase.$description: Transforms text to uppercase for emphasis or labels.

capitalize.$description: Capitalizes first letter of each word.
